data.description:
## Context
F09 found `/rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key` and `MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY` in deployment documentation, Terraform, secret-loading scripts, and a restore runbook. No compose or application consumer appeared in the repository search. Closed infrastructure tickets record why the secret was introduced, but ADR 0049 replaced gated HMAC signing with environment-attributed Ed25519 operation certificates. Removal must follow an evidence-based compatibility and deployment assessment.

Known paths include `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md`, `infra/scripts/fetch-secrets.sh`, `infra/runbooks/provision-restore.md`, `infra/terraform/ssm.tf`, and `infra/terraform/user_data.sh`.

## Plan
- Trace every producer, transport, and consumer of the parameter and environment variable.
- Compare the current deployed service contract with ADR 0049 and the operation-certificate key path.
- Determine whether any supported rollback, migration, or generic HMAC consumer still requires the secret.
- Propose retention, deprecation, or removal with an exact file and deployment impact.
- Do not remove infrastructure before operator approval.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every repository reference and runtime consumer is identified.
- [ ] The originating closed tickets and superseding ADR decisions are cited.
- [ ] The recommendation states compatibility, rollback, and secret-rotation consequences.
- [ ] Any remediation proposal has a bounded file and deployment impact.
- [ ] No infrastructure is changed during the assessment.
data.title: Assess obsolete MCP HMAC secret infrastructure
